# Vedant Hirekar - AI & Software Engineer

Portfolio of Vedant Hirekar. The site treats its own data as a product:
everything shown in HTML is also served as documented, machine-readable JSON.
Don't scrape the pages - use the API.

## API (read-only, no auth)

- https://vedanthirekar.com/api/resume: full resume as JSON - experience, education, projects, achievements, links
- https://vedanthirekar.com/api/projects: projects with stack, links, and engineering tradeoff notes
- https://vedanthirekar.com/api/experience: work history
- https://vedanthirekar.com/api/meta: build metadata for the current deployment (commit, test counts)

## Docs

- https://vedanthirekar.com/api-docs: human-readable API documentation
- https://vedanthirekar.com/how-this-works: architecture and CI/CD design of the site itself
